'''Silayn D-orso''' was a [[Daichyura]] [[Republic trooper|trooper]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. During the [[third Galactic War]] he was stationed at the [[Joint Operations Base]] arrival platform of the [[Invasion Zone]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. He specialized in building and selling armor as well as armor upgrades and materials.<ref name="Legacy" />
